audit.root_cause: load_environment requires a Chroma DB at <site-packages>/.chroma_db that is neither shipped nor built on demand. The README's prepare step writes `.chroma_db` into the source checkout's CWD, not into the installed package, so even a user who follows the README hits this.
audit.evidence: src/mouns__prior-art-search/prior_art_search.py:12-14 `BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent` / `DEFAULT_CHROMA_DIR = BASE_DIR / ".chroma_db"`, :117-118 raise `Missing Chroma DB ... Run prepare.py first.`; prepare.py:12 `DEFAULT_CHROMA_DIR = ".chroma_db"` (CWD-relative); README.md:57-67 runs prepare in the repo dir before `prime env install`
audit.irl_fix: Build/download the Chroma index lazily into a user cache dir (e.g. ~/.cache/prior-art-search) inside load_environment, or default chroma_dir to an env var/absolute path that prepare.py also uses.
